request.description:
Creates a new Account record with maximum fields populated. Includes:
- Required fields (Name, Type, Account_Status__c, Region__c)
- Contact information (Phone, Fax, Website)
- Billing and Shipping addresses (complete)
- Company information (Industry, Revenue, Employees)
- Custom fields (Account Team Roles, Admission Status, etc.)

**Duplicate Detection Handling:**
- A pre-request script automatically generates a unique account name using timestamp and random ID
- Format: `ACC{randomId}{randomNum}_MaxFields_{timestamp}`
- This ensures each request creates a unique account, avoiding duplicate detection errors
- If you still get duplicates, manually edit the Name field in the request body

**Note on UI-only fields (not accessible via REST API):**
- `State_Province__c`: Exists in UI but NOT accessible via API (Field-Level Security or read-only)
  - Validation rule requiring State_Province__c when Region is US is satisfied by setting BillingState
  - State_Province__c may be auto-populated from BillingState in the UI
- `Country__c`: Exists in UI but NOT accessible via API (Field-Level Security or read-only)
  - Use `BillingCountry` instead, which is accessible via API
  - Country__c may be auto-populated from BillingCountry in the UI

**Variables Required:**
- `{{instanceUrl}}` - Salesforce instance URL (e.g., https://arx--qa.sandbox.my.salesforce.com)
- `{{apiVersion}}` - API version (e.g., 59.0)
- `{{accessToken}}` - Salesforce access token
- `{{uniqueAccountName}}` - Auto-generated by pre-request script
